diners.eating_share.name: Share of residents who eat at hawker centres
diners.eating_share.source: NEA Perception Survey of Hawker Centre Patrons 2018 (adults 18-69, applied to all residents in 2026); the Assumptions panel states this stretch

diners.visits_per_week.base.name: Hawker centre visits per week, base case

diners.visits_per_week.min.name: Hawker centre visits per week, low end of range

diners.visits_per_week.max.name: Hawker centre visits per week, high end of range

undercount_factor.name: Possibly under-counted: residents per stall below this share of the median
undercount_factor.source: Spec 2 / Spec 3 check on silver: 0.1 flags 18 centres, mostly CBD and Chinatown; can also flag tight clusters

access.super_aged_share.name: Super-aged threshold, share of residents aged 65+
access.super_aged_share.source: MOH definition of a super-aged society; NPTD Population in Brief 2026. Our share uses SingStat HDB residents, the official figure uses citizens

access.food_point_min_seniors.name: Temporary food point if at least this many seniors in one area have no open centre within the walking cutoff
access.food_point_min_seniors.source: Team proposal (ASSUMPTIONS.md, suggested support, #78); not yet checked against AAC or NEA practice

access.severity.severe_priority_areas.name: A closure is Severe if at least this many priority areas lose their walk
access.severity.severe_priority_areas.source: Team proposal (ASSUMPTIONS.md, severity, #79); not yet checked with AACs

access.severity.severe_no_walk_seniors.name: A closure is Severe if at least this many seniors are left with no centre anyone can walk to
access.severity.severe_no_walk_seniors.source: Team proposal (ASSUMPTIONS.md, severity, #79); not yet checked with AACs

access.sensitivity_limits_min.name: Extra time limits for the sensitivity runs (the base limit is walk.limit_min)

access.min_subzone_residents.name: Fewest HDB residents for a subzone to get a % aged 65+ and a multiplier

verdict.access.min_new_blocks.name: Red if at least this many more blocks lose a centre within the limit at senior pace
verdict.access.min_new_blocks.source: Spec 3: closing together must not cut anyone off who is not already cut off by either closure alone

verdict.share.red.name: Red if the added centre takes at least this share of the rest of the plan's displaced diners
verdict.share.red.source: Page 1 logic spec (2026-10-26): the added centre is where the anchor's diners would go

verdict.share.yellow.name: Yellow if the added centre takes at least this share of the rest of the plan's displaced diners

verdict.load.red_pct.name: Red if closing together makes a third centre more than this much busier than today, and neither closure alone does
verdict.load.red_pct.source: Page 1 logic spec (2026-10-26); matches the wireframe +20% flag

verdict.load.yellow_pct.name: Yellow if closing together makes a third centre more than this much busier than today, and neither closure alone does

actions.waste.flag_pct.name: NEA actions flag when a centre gets more than this much busier than today
actions.waste.flag_pct.source: Wireframe v1 (+20% waste flag); Page 1 logic spec (2026-10-26)

waste.kg_per_diner_per_day.low.name: Food waste per diner per day, low end of range
waste.kg_per_diner_per_day.low.source: Bracketed, not measured: NEA 2015 pilot (>1 t/day each at Tiong Bahru and Ang Mo Kio 628) over our modelled diners; CAS 93 g/meal for China catering. No published Singapore per-diner figure (#57)

waste.kg_per_diner_per_day.base.name: Food waste per diner per day, base case
waste.kg_per_diner_per_day.base.source: Bracketed, not measured: NEA 2015 pilot (>1 t/day each at Tiong Bahru and Ang Mo Kio 628) over our modelled diners; CAS 93 g/meal for China catering. No published Singapore per-diner figure (#57)

waste.kg_per_diner_per_day.high.name: Food waste per diner per day, high end of range
waste.kg_per_diner_per_day.high.source: Bracketed, not measured: NEA 2015 pilot (>1 t/day each at Tiong Bahru and Ang Mo Kio 628) over our modelled diners; CAS 93 g/meal for China catering. No published Singapore per-diner figure (#57)

plan.max_extra_centres.name: Most centres that can close alongside the anchor

candidates.max_shown.name: Most centres listed as candidates to schedule alongside

candidates.rr_cycle_years.name: Years between NEA Repairs and Redecoration (R&R) at a hawker centre
candidates.rr_cycle_years.source: MSE written reply to PQ, 3 Aug 2023 (Minister Grace Fu): "Hawker centres and markets typically undergo cyclical Repairs and Redecoration (R&R) every 6 to 8 years"; the low end is used, so a centre counts as due sooner
